note: Finalized: audited drivers/vhost/{vhost.c,vringh.c,net.c,vsock.c,scsi.c,test.c}, drivers/virtio/{virtio_ring.c,virtio.c,virtio_pci_*.c}, drivers/net/virtio_net.c, include/linux/virtio_net.h, net/core/skbuff.c. Descriptor tables are consistently snapshotted into a local struct vring_desc before use. Primary reported finding: drivers/net/virtio_net.c receive_buf() re-reads guest/device-writable virtio_net_hdr fields (hdr->hdr.flags read for CHECKSUM_UNNECESSARY decision, then hdr passed again to virtio_net_hdr_to_skb which re-reads flags/csum_start/csum_offset for validation and skb_partial_csum_set) without a single fetch; also num_buffers read twice in receive_mergeable.

candidates.reason: receive_buf() reads shared vnet hdr flags at 1021 for checksum-validity decision, then re-reads all hdr fields inside virtio_net_hdr_to_skb at 1024; validated copy vs used copy can diverge under racing device/guest writer. No single fetch or READ_ONCE.

vhost_get_vq_desc copies each descriptor into local 'struct vring_desc desc' via vhost_copy_from_user once; all later uses (flags/addr/len) read the local copy. next_desc READ_ONCE(desc->next) also reads the local copy.
__vringh_iov copies each descriptor into local 'struct vring_desc desc' and uses only the local copy including split-range retry arithmetic.
virtqueue_get_buf_ctx reads used ring id once into local i, validates i < vring.num and desc_state[i].data before detach_buf; no second fetch of the same field.
avail ring head read once into ring_head, converted to local head, bounds-checked head >= vq->num before use as index; subsequent loop re-validates each i.
num_buffers read at 765 into local num_buf for loop control; but line ~908 re-reads hdr->num_buffers only for a debug message after loop, so no validated-vs-used divergence. Minor, benign.
